title: Scaffold shippin.tech clients and contracts without inventing .ai product domains

costar.context: suite_readiness_assess is done. Engine and scale path are strong. The missing surface is shippin.tech's own clients and mailcow-grade ops packaging. .ai/modules is agent operating context only.
costar.objective: Lock a schema-first product tree under shippin.tech: rename zoho-client to shippin-clients, add contracts/ and clients/, keep Zoho and mailcow as later importers, defer Docs, leave .ai as ops-only.
costar.style: Folder and contract scaffolding first; no second mail server; one binary.
costar.audience: The maintainer and the next coding agent.
costar.response: Draft plan filed; rename and contracts/clients trees wait for approval before implementation.

concerns: Treating .ai/modules as product domains invents architecture the assessment never had.
Keeping the roadmap id zoho-client will keep agents building a Zoho skin instead of shippin.tech clients.
Clients that skip contracts/ will couple to private Rust types and break the one-binary boundary.
Starting Docs or importers before mail/calendar/contacts/admin reopens the suite trap the assessment closed.
context: The readiness assessment scored engine strong, mailcow ops weak, suite clients not started, Docs out of scope. The next build is own clients on existing JMAP, CalDAV, CardDAV, and directory.
current_state: Roadmap phase is still named zoho-client. No contracts/ or clients/ tree. OpenAPI and protocol crates exist. .ai/ holds chats, plans, roadmap, journal, costar, canon only.
target_design: Product mindmap under shippin.tech: crates + api + resources + contracts + clients + later importers. shippin.cloud hosts the same binary. Zoho and mailcow are import sources after own clients work. Docs stays deferred.
changes: Rename roadmap phase zoho-client to shippin-clients and update product-boundaries and README wording to own clients.
Add contracts/ pins for OpenAPI, JMAP allowlist, DAV, and directory/SCIM that clients bind to.
Add clients/{mail,calendar,contacts,admin} skeletons that only speak those contracts against one shippin-tech binary.
Add contract conformance tests under tests/.
Leave importers/ and Docs untouched until clients and ops packaging are real.
Do not add product domains under .ai/modules.
boundaries: No second mail server (Mox, Postfix, Dovecot) and no Go control plane.
No Zoho UI clone; Zoho and mailcow are later importers only.
No collaborative Docs editor in this plan.
Do not relicense LicenseRef-SEL blocks or remove enterprise from the default build.

verification.name: operating-tree-consistent
verification.proves: The new plan record and any roadmap rename still match module schemas.

verification.name: no-invented-ai-product-domains
verification.proves: Scaffolding did not create .ai product-domain modules.
